No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.
